raw_market.question: Will Missouri be ranked #1 on the Week 7 AP Poll?
raw_market.description:
This market will resolve to the team ranked #1 (first position) of the Week 7 Associated Press (AP) Top 25 college football poll for the 2026 season.

The "Week 7 AP poll" refers to the AP Top 25 poll released in Week 7 of the 2026 regular season, expected on October 18, 2026. The preseason poll does not count.

If the team ranked #1 is not among the listed teams, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source will be the official Associated Press Top 25 college football poll (https://apnews.com/hub/ap-top-25-college-football-poll); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
